```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(echarts4r)

```


```{r}
# Cargar los datos
person_person <- read.csv("data/Person_Person.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
person_org <- read.csv("data/Person_Org.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
org_org <- read.csv("data/Org_Org.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
approval_polllist <- ("data/")
```


```{r}
glimpse(person_person)
```


```{r}
# Crear nodos y enlaces
nodes <- data.frame(name = unique(c(person_person$Column1, person_person$Column2, 
                                    person_org$Column1, person_org$Column2, 
                                    org_org$Column1, org_org$Column2)))

edges <- rbind(person_person, person_org, org_org)

```



```{r}
# Crear el gráfico de red
e_charts() %>%
  e_graph_gl() %>%
  e_graph_nodes(nodes, name) %>%
  e_graph_edges(edges, Column1, Column2)
```
